title: Håstad three-SAT OXR error bound
statement: For a natural number $t$ and a real number $\varepsilon$, define the OXR error to be $\min\{1,\frac14\sqrt{\varepsilon/(1-\varepsilon)^{t-1}}\}$ when $\varepsilon<1$, and to be $1$ when $\varepsilon\ge1$.
